state_definitions.official-documented-native-not-run: A public first-party source documents the feature, but no matching local executable was found and no native command was run.
state_definitions.guard-supported-synthetic-only: The offline guard implements only the narrow synthetic parser/evidence profile stated in SKILL.md; this is not native provider support.
state_definitions.guard-not-supported: The feature is discoverable for planning, but the offline guard must block it.

native_validation.reason: g16, g09, formchk, and cubegen were not found; licensed execution and installation were not authorized.

sources.version_scope: Gaussian 16 Rev. C.01 public page; C.02 revision boundary is separate
Gaussian 16 Rev. C.01 public utility page; output-format option includes Gaussian 16
Gaussian 16 Rev. C.02 platform list, dated 2025-03-18

features.summary: Link 0, route, title, molecule specification, and optional sections have ordered blank-line boundaries.
features.failure_semantics: A missing required blank-line terminator or malformed section prevents a trustworthy parse.
features.scientific_gate: Syntax acceptance alone establishes no method adequacy or molecular identity.

features.summary: %Mem, %Chk, %OldChk, %CPU, %NProcShared, and related Link 0 commands precede the route.
features.failure_semantics: Resource and checkpoint directives are not scientific defaults and checkpoint paths require explicit lineage.
features.scientific_gate: A checkpoint name is not checkpoint identity; bind its bytes and ancestry separately.

features.summary: On a configured Unix installation, g16 job-name reads job-name.gjf and writes job-name.log.
features.failure_semantics: Missing setup, scratch policy, entitlement, executable, input, or writable output blocks execution.
features.scientific_gate: Capture exact input/output hashes, exit status, revision text, and checkpoint identity.

features.summary: The documented Unix redirection form is g16 < input-file > output-file.
features.failure_semantics: Shell redirection may create a partial log even when Gaussian fails; file existence is not completion.
features.scientific_gate: Require provider termination evidence and task-specific completion evidence, not only process exit or a log file.

features.summary: SP requests a single-point energy calculation for the supplied geometry.
features.failure_semantics: SCF failure, error termination, revision mismatch, or missing final energy blocks technical acceptance.
features.scientific_gate: Converge method, basis, integration, SCF, and geometry choices for the intended observable.

features.summary: Opt searches for a stationary point and defaults to a local minimum search unless another target is requested.
features.failure_semantics: Normal termination without the optimization-completed condition is not an accepted optimization.
features.scientific_gate: A converged local structure is not a global minimum; follow with a same-level frequency calculation.

features.summary: Freq computes vibrational frequencies and related properties from the Hessian.
features.failure_semantics: A frequency job at a nonstationary or different-level geometry cannot establish the intended stationary-point type.
features.scientific_gate: Minimum candidates require zero meaningful imaginary modes; transition-state candidates require one intended mode, with near-zero modes examined.

features.summary: Opt Freq is a documented combined workflow for optimizing and then computing frequencies.
features.failure_semantics: Both optimization and frequency evidence must belong to the same bound job or explicit checkpoint/geometry lineage.
features.scientific_gate: Thermochemistry also requires appropriate model chemistry, standard-state, temperature, scaling, and mode treatment.

features.summary: Opt=QST2/QST3 and Opt=TS are documented transition-structure search routes with strict structure/atom-order requirements.
features.failure_semantics: Wrong atom ordering, wrong stationary point, or more/less than one intended imaginary mode blocks a transition-state claim.
features.scientific_gate: Verify the imaginary eigenvector and connect both intended endpoints with IRC evidence.

features.summary: IRC follows the reaction path from a transition structure and requires force constants through ReadFC or CalcFC.
features.failure_semantics: A missing Hessian, unconverged path, one-sided path, or wrong endpoints blocks connectivity evidence.
features.scientific_gate: Endpoint structures must be optimized/identified independently and the path must correspond to the intended mode.

features.summary: Opt=Restart continues an interrupted optimization from checkpoint data.
features.failure_semantics: Restart without the exact parent checkpoint and compatible route/environment breaks ancestry.
features.scientific_gate: Bind parent and child input, log, and checkpoint hashes; rerun final acceptance gates after completion.

features.summary: formchk converts a binary checkpoint to a formatted checkpoint using formchk [options] chkpt-file [formatted-file].
features.failure_semantics: Conversion failure, wrong checkpoint identity, or an unbound output prevents downstream use.
features.scientific_gate: Formatted output is a representation change, not independent validation; protect proprietary/private contents.

features.summary: cubegen produces cube data such as Density=type or MO=n from a formatted checkpoint.
features.failure_semantics: Wrong density/MO selector, grid, units, format, or parent formatted-checkpoint identity invalidates the artifact.
features.scientific_gate: Record grid origin/axes/counts, quantity, orbital/state, units, and parent hash before analysis or plotting.

features.summary: Gaussian revision text in a bound output and the C.02 platform list are separate identity/compatibility evidence.
features.failure_semantics: A revision claim, filename, or unsupported host cannot substitute for a trusted environment record.
features.scientific_gate: Current macOS 26.5.2 is outside the public C.02 Apple M-series matrix (macOS 12-15), so native execution remains blocked here.
